description:
- Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC) has introduced new families of \var{N} computer systems with different memory, disk storage, and expansion capabilities.
- Each system \var{i} is either a general-purpose (GP) system or a workstation (WS) system.
- Each system \var{i} can have an integer number of disk drives, and on average \var{disk_i} units of disk drive per system are requested by customers for system \var{i}.
- System \var{i} uses \var{mem_i} units of 256K memory boards per system on average.
- System \var{i} has a price of \var{price_i} dollars.
- The in-house supplier of CPUs for DEC could provide at most \var{max_cpu} units, due to debugging problems.
- The supply of disk drives is uncertain and is estimated by the manufacturer to be in the range of \var{min_disk} to \var{max_disk} units.
- the supply of 256K memory boards is also limited in the range of \var{min_mem} to \var{max_mem} units.
- Maximum demand for system \var{i} in the next quarter is estimated to be \var{demand_i} units.
- Maximum demand for the whole GP family in the next quarter is estimated to be \var{demand_GP} units.
- Maximum demand for the whole WS family in the next quarter is estimated to be \var{demand_WS} units.
- Included in the projections, there are \var{preorder_i} orders for system \var{i} that have already been received and have to be fulfilled in the next quarter.
- To address the shortage of 256K memory boards, DEC has access to \var{alt_mem} units of an alternative memory board that can only be used in certain systems.
- you can assume the number of systems produced is a floating point number to make the problem easier to solve.

IsWorkstation.definition: Whether system i is a workstation (true) or general-purpose (false)

Price.definition: Price of system i in dollars

DiskDrives.definition: Average number of disk drives per unit of system i

MemoryBoards.definition: Number of 256K memory boards per unit of system i

DemandGP.definition: Maximum total demand for all general-purpose systems

DemandWS.definition: Maximum total demand for all workstation systems

Preorder.definition: Number of pre-orders for system i that must be fulfilled

AltMemory.definition: Number of alternative memory boards available

AltCompatible.definition: Whether alternative memory board is compatible with system i

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total revenue from producing and selling the computer systems"
objective.code: model.setObjective(quicksum(Price[i] * x[i] for i in range(N)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)

constraints.description: For each system i, the number of units produced x_i must be greater than or equal to the number of preorders: x_i >= Preorder_i
constraints.code:
for i in range(N):
    model.addConstr(x[i] >= Preorder[i])

constraints.description: For each system i, the number of units produced x_i must not exceed its maximum demand: x_i <= Demand_i
constraints.code:
for i in range(N):
    model.addConstr(x[i] <= Demand[i])

constraints.description: The total number of systems produced cannot exceed the available CPUs: sum_i x_i <= MaxCpu
constraints.code: model.addConstr(sum(x[i] for i in range(N)) <= MaxCpu)

constraints.description: The total disk drives used cannot exceed the available disk supply: sum_i (DiskDrives_i * x_i) <= MaxDisk
For each system i, the total memory boards required must be satisfied by regular and alternative boards: r_i + a_i = MemoryBoards_i * x_i
constraints.formulation: $\\forall i = 1, \\dots, N:\\; r_i + a_i = MemoryBoards_i \\cdot x_i$
constraints.code:
for i in range(N):
    model.addConstr(r[i] + a[i] == MemoryBoards[i] * x[i])

constraints.description: The total regular memory boards used cannot exceed the available regular memory supply: sum_i r_i <= MaxMemory
constraints.code: model.addConstr(sum(r[i] for i in range(N)) <= MaxMemory)

constraints.description: The total alternative memory boards used cannot exceed the available alternative memory: sum_i a_i <= AltMemory
constraints.code: model.addConstr(sum(a[i] for i in range(N)) <= AltMemory)

constraints.description: Alternative memory boards can only be used for compatible systems: a_i <= AltCompatible_i * (MemoryBoards_i * x_i) for all i
constraints.formulation: $\\forall i = 1, \\dots, N:\\; a_i \\leq AltCompatible_i \\cdot MemoryBoards_i \\cdot x_i$
constraints.code:
for i in range(N):
    model.addConstr(a[i] <= AltCompatible[i] * MemoryBoards[i] * x[i])

constraints.description: The total production of general-purpose systems cannot exceed their family demand: sum_{i: IsWorkstation_i = false} x_i <= DemandGP
The total production of workstation systems cannot exceed their family demand: sum_{i: IsWorkstation_i = true} x_i <= DemandWS
Non-negativity constraints: x_i >= 0, r_i >= 0, a_i >= 0 for all i
constraints.code:
for i in range(N):
    model.addConstr(x[i] >= 0)
    model.addConstr(r[i] >= 0)
    model.addConstr(a[i] >= 0)

x.definition: Number of units produced for system i

r.definition: Number of regular 256K memory boards used for system i

a.definition: Number of alternative memory boards used for system i
